note: Committed demo phrasing for the weekly ramp plan. Demo mode never calls a model: src/lib/model-purposes.ts picks the top of each pool decided by code (src/lib/ramp-signals.ts) and fills these lines only with facts from that pool, so every demo sentence passes the same fact check as a live one. {signal} is the strongest reason for the skill gap; {fact} and {fact2} are the item's own facts.

learn.document: {signal}. Start with this {kindNoun} about {service}, written by {author}.
learn.employee: {signal}. {first} is a good person to learn it from: {evidence}. Ask for 20 minutes this week.

stretch.taskWithLead: Ask {lead} for one small, self-contained piece of {title} that you can finish this week{skillPart}.
stretch.taskNoLead: Pick one small, self-contained piece of {title} that you can finish this week{skillPart}.

meet.why: {fact2}. A short intro now means you know who to ask before you are blocked.
